claims.text: Regime: the four-disc sequence of K9001 to K9004, RTX 4060, 5% replay budget, original output, at the training learning rate. Snapshot labels are the network's own output when the phase began: no stored labels, but a copy of that output and the locations of earlier discs are needed. Informed by K9101 and K9104, so not blind. forget_held is forgetting on disc pixels no later phase used as replay pixels. Apple keeps the output trap, so most checks exclude it. Claim: focused replay loses little without stored labels: forget at most 1.5 times focused replay with stored targets; >= 3 times falsifies.
